name: atlas-os
description: ATLAS // MASTER OS — local-first No Man's Sky companion with an offline mirror of the wiki's game data

scripts.build: pnpm index:wiki && pnpm --filter @atlas/web build --mode site --outDir dist-site/app --emptyOutDir && pnpm --filter @atlas/site build --outDir ../web/dist-site --emptyOutDir false && cp apps/site/_headers apps/site/_redirects apps/web/dist-site/
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/web/src/sw && tsc -p apps/site && tsc -p apps/sync && tsc -p apps/mcp
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @atlas/web build --mode e2e && pnpm --filter @atlas/site build && playwright test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
